text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, how did you like our birthday<n>celebration,
Yaeno?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! The Itty Bitty Critters Petting Zoo<n>possessed
destructive power beyond<n>all imagining!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
They were all so cute, weren't they?<n>They had
bunnies, squirrels, and<n>guinea pigs too...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes! To think there was such a place<n>on this earth...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
N-now, I know it was my birthday, but<n>do you think
it was okay for me to<n>have them all to myself?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You two must have wanted to show<n>the critters
some love too, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Right. Getting to see our adorable<n>Yaeno enjoying
her time with the<n>critters was more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Y-you jest! I am far too uncouth to be<n>deserving of
that word!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I don't think that's true at all. Even<n>the way you're
getting all flustered<n>now is cute too.
